title: Why your brain begs for one more scroll

scenes.visual: Big hook text on cream card, Norb peeking curious from the bottom
Cute brain character pops in next to a jittery Norb
scenes.voiceover: Your brain is not weak. It is running a very old program.

scenes.visual: Dopamine molecule character bounces in, Norb panics
scenes.voiceover: Every swipe might be a reward, so dopamine says check one more.

scenes.visual: Cortisol drop appears, Norb is exhausted
scenes.voiceover: But random rewards never satisfy, they just keep the loop spinning.

scenes.visual: Norb gets a lightbulb moment, brain character celebrates
scenes.voiceover: The fix is friction. Move the app, log out, make checking cost effort.

scenes.visual: Sources card, Norb celebrating in the corner
